messages.subject: control.inla / correct  usage?
parts:
[Using  Using  INLA 21.02.23]

The answer to question 19 on the R-INLA FAQ leads us to a suggestion to 
include

 control.inla=list(correct=TRUE, correct.factor=<var>)

 in the inla call. I tried this, and got a list of legal args to control.inla, in which
"correct" isn't there.  There is a setting in control.inla for control.correct, but
using

inla( ... ,control.inla=list(control.correct=list(enable=TRUE))     or
inla( ... ,control.inla=list(control.correct=list(correct=TRUE)) 

seems to make no difference. I expect I'm not setting this up correctly:
could someone tell me the right syntax?

Thanks!
